evidence: The surface morphologies of Ru thin films were observed by atomic force microscope (AFM). The capacitors of ALD Ru/HfO2/p-Si and PVD Ru/HfO2/p-Si, the capacitance–voltage (C–V) and the current–voltage (I–V) characteristics were determined by using Keithley 4200 semiconductor parameter analyzer with HP4284 LCR meter. The midgap interface state density (Dit) was obtained by conductance methods.
